privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introText: Virginia Institute of Finance and Management ("VIFM", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our e-learning platform.
privacyPolicy.collectText: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, organization details, and payment information when you register for an account, enroll in courses, or contact us. We also automatically collect usage data such as pages visited, courses accessed, video watch progress, and device information.
privacyPolicy.useText: We use the information we collect to provide and maintain our e-learning services, process enrollments and payments, track your learning progress and issue certificates, send you course updates and relevant notifications, improve our platform and develop new features, and comply with legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.shareText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with instructors (limited to course-related information), corporate administrators (if enrolled through an organization), payment processors to complete transactions, and service providers who assist in operating our platform.
privacyPolicy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption of data in transit and at rest, secure authentication mechanisms, and regular security audits.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and analyze platform usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.
privacyPolicy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also request a copy of your data or withdraw consent for certain processing activities. To exercise these rights, please contact us.
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@vifm.edu or through our Contact page.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.introText: By accessing or using the VIFM Academy e-learning platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.
termsOfService.accountText: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
termsOfService.enrollmentText: Course access is granted upon successful enrollment and payment (if applicable). Access duration depends on the course or subscription plan purchased. We reserve the right to modify course content to keep it current and relevant.
termsOfService.paymentText: All prices are displayed in the applicable currency. Payments are processed securely through our payment partners. Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of enrollment if less than 25% of the course has been accessed. Subscription cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
termsOfService.contentText: All course content, materials, videos, and platform features are the intellectual property of VIFM or its licensors. You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or create derivative works from any content without explicit written permission.
termsOfService.conductText: You agree not to share your account credentials, redistribute course materials, use automated tools to access or download content, engage in any activity that disrupts the platform, or post inappropriate content in discussion forums.
termsOfService.certificatesText: Certificates are issued upon successful completion of course requirements, including assessments where applicable. VIFM reserves the right to revoke certificates obtained through fraudulent means.
termsOfService.corporateText: Organizations with corporate accounts are responsible for managing their employee access and ensuring compliance with these terms. Corporate license terms are governed by the separate corporate agreement.
termsOfService.disclaimerText: Our platform and content are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. While we strive for accuracy, we do not guarantee that course content is error-free or that the platform will be uninterrupted.
termsOfService.liabilityText: VIFM shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the twelve months preceding the claim.
termsOfService.changesText: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. We will notify registered users of significant changes via email.
termsOfService.contactText: For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at legal@vifm.edu or through our Contact page.
